name: Hokkaido Coca-Cola Bottling Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hokkaido Coca-Cola Bottling Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells of beverages in Japan. It sells its products under the Coca Cola, FANTA, Sprite, I LOHAS, AQUARIUS, Qoo, Ayataka, Barley tea in a kettle, Koucha Kaden, Georgia, Costa Coffee, Kira Fans, Sokenbicha, Canda Dry, Real Gold, Body Healthy Tea, Jack Daniel's & Coca-Cola, and Lemon-do brands, and other limited edition brands, such as I LOHAS Haskap, Georgia Milk Coffee, Georgia banana milk coffee, Georgia The Blend, and Georgia Santos Premium names. The company was incorporated in 1940 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan. Hokkaido Coca-Cola Bottling Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Dai Nippon Printing Co., Ltd.
